propositions: Jira mutations are currently scattered across differ, apply wrapper, Cloud ACLI/REST, Jira DC SDK, handlers, and batch orchestration with multiplied retry ownership and no stable per-ticket versus batch failure scope.

A provider-neutral coordinator must be built around immutable TicketPlan values carrying Mutation, lifecycle intents, dependencies, diagnostics, and disposition, with global selection/filter/caps applied before any lifecycle or remote effect.

Each logical postcondition must be executed within three physical invocations and 15 seconds cumulative sleep, with approximately 2s then 4s fallback delays, and long waits deferred via retry_not_before.
A new endpoint-failure scoped fuse must trigger after three consecutive exhausted eligible outcomes across at least two tickets, distinct from and retaining the existing per-pass blast-radius guard.
Shadow planning and versioned preview lifecycle intents must be produced from one observation with zero remote/local effects, comparable to existing mutation shape without dual-writes.
Live External Integration testing must gate closure, exercising the coordinator end-to-end against both live Jira Cloud and live Jira Data Center instances with real transports and credentials.
